references.text: Proverbs describes how the Lord disciplines those he loves, just as a father disciplines his son—the same theme of God's fatherly discipline
Job speaks of the blessing of being disciplined by the Almighty and warns against despising His correction
Hebrews quotes and expands on the principle of God's fatherly discipline, explaining that discipline is a sign that we are His children
Jesus says that He rebukes and disciplines those He loves, reflecting the same father-child relationship between God and His people
The psalmist describes as blessed the one whom the Lord disciplines and teaches His law—discipline combined with instruction
The psalmist acknowledges that before he was humbled, he went astray, but now he keeps God's word—discipline leads to obedience
Earlier in Deuteronomy it is described how the Lord carried Israel as a man carries his son—the same father-son relationship
